topic: Deep Learning with TensorFlow and Keras
learningObjectives: Understand the basic workflow of building a neural network with Keras
Identify layers, activation functions, loss functions, and optimizers
Trace the training process of a neural network

activities.title: Keras Model Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each model component to reveal its purpose.

content.concept: A Keras model is composed of layers that transform inputs and produce predictions.

activities.instruction: Connect layers to create a simple Keras model.

content.concept: Neural networks are constructed by connecting layers that progressively transform input representations.

activities.title: Training Configuration
activities.instruction: Match each training component with its role.

content.concept: Loss functions measure prediction error, while optimizers update model parameters to reduce that error.

activities.title: Training Loop
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages of a neural network training cycle.

content.concept: Training repeatedly performs forward passes, calculates loss, computes updates, and adjusts model parameters.
